anf_compare.notes: No public-domain English of De Oratione exists (only copyrighted Greer/O'Meara/Oulton-Chadwick); nothing to compare against. Sense checked against the Greek and cited Scripture wording.

apparatus: Ps 33:8; Gen 48:16; Tobit/Raphael; 1 Cor 5:4; Isa 1:12-15; Ps 25:4-5; fig tree.

choices.why: Men's and angels' assemblies coincide over the gathering — Origen's boldest ecclesiological image; keep it stark.
sōmatopoieō = made into one body; the gathered are bodied in Christ — coinage kept.
peristasis = circumstance; the norm/exception pastoral structure (sailing, fever) turns on this term.

pass_a_gloss: Elementary appendix: condition on soul, figure on body (1 Tim 2:8; Ps 140; Wis 16); preparation rite with soul-before-hands and grudge-renunciation; extended hands normative, seated/reclining/sailing exceptional; kneeling as subjection-sign with cosmic Phil 2:10 (spherical heavens have no knees); every place fit yet house's reverend spot examined (marriage concession); assembly's double church of men, angels, Lord's power, departed — and its dark twin of impious with wicked angels; forsaken gatherings wither like the fig tree.
